_doc: Caption presets rendered as ASS subtitles by app/pipeline/captions.py. Colors are #RRGGBB. 'mode': word (one word at a time), chunk (a short phrase with the active word highlighted), stack (small lead-in line + big keyword), boxed (bold pill backdrop). Fonts live in backend/fonts.

hormozi.name: Hormozi Bold Yellow/White
hormozi.description: Heavy uppercase, thick black stroke, active word in yellow, keyword pop.

single_word_pop.name: Single Word Pop
single_word_pop.description: One condensed word at a time, center screen, vibrant accent colors on numbers and keywords.

netflix_kinetic.name: Netflix Kinetic
netflix_kinetic.description: Tall cinematic caps, red accent, word slams in with scale + fade.

neon_glow.name: Neon Glow
neon_glow.description: Elegant serif words with a colored neon halo that shifts per keyword.

minimal_clean.name: Minimalist Clean
minimal_clean.description: Small, tidy sentence-case captions with a soft shadow.

gaming_stack.name: Gaming Stack
gaming_stack.description: Small white lead-in line with a giant italic colored keyword under it.

cinematic_cyan.name: Cinematic Single Word
cinematic_cyan.description: Wide-tracked uppercase word in pale cyan, mid-screen. Luxury / storytelling vibe.

bold_boxed.name: Boxed High-Contrast
bold_boxed.description: Crisp white phrase over a dark semi-opaque backdrop pill for busy backgrounds.
